context: M13 o5. Bryant Park, west terrace, rain on the leaves. Ricky shakes.

lines.speaker: char.ricky_vail
lines.text: Fifteen to life, man. For a bag. So yeah, I talk to cops. You would too.

lines.speaker: char.delphine_moore
lines.text: Who do you talk to, Ricky?

lines.speaker: char.ricky_vail
lines.text: The big one. Sneakers. He wants to know where the women keep their money.

lines.speaker: char.ricky_vail
lines.text: Not yet. I'm not a rat. I'm a guy with a calendar. He's coming now. Hide.
